products.name: Sterile Water for Injection
products.tagline: Single-use FFS vials with in-built twist-off cap
products.summary: Sterile, non-pyrogenic Water for Injection in 5, 10, 20, 25 and 30 ml single-use vials, manufactured on Form-Fill-Seal lines from a hot WFI loop maintained at 80 °C and above.
description: Sterile Water for Injection (SWFI) is the diluent and solvent of choice for reconstituting powders for injection and for diluting parenteral drugs before administration. Swanya manufactures SWFI from its in-house Water For Injection system — multi-column distillation fed by Purified Water and pure steam, stored hot and circulated continuously — and fills it on Form-Fill-Seal machines so that the container is formed, filled and hermetically sealed in a single closed cycle.

Each vial carries an in-built twist-off cap. There is no glass to break, no separate stopper to contaminate and no particulate risk from ampoule opening, which makes the presentation well suited to hospital wards, emergency kits and high-throughput nursing environments.

Every batch is released only after in-house testing in Swanya's segregated wet, instrument and micro laboratories, including conductivity, pH, bacterial endotoxin (pyrogen) and microbial limit testing on the WFI loop, plus sterility and particulate matter on the finished product.
specs: Sterile liquid — solvent / diluent for parenteral use
Single-use FFS vial with in-built twist-off cap
In-house WFI, stored and circulated at ≥ 80 °C
Filtration with online filter integrity testing; autoclaving / SIP for equipment
In-house: conductivity, pH, BET, microbial limit, sterility

products.name: Normal Saline Solution
products.tagline: 10 ml single-use FFS vials with in-built twist-off cap
products.summary: Isotonic sodium chloride solution in 10 ml single-use Form-Fill-Seal vials with in-built twist-off cap, for dilution, flushing and reconstitution.
description: Normal Saline (0.9% w/v sodium chloride) is the most widely used isotonic solution in clinical practice. Swanya fills it in 10 ml single-use FFS vials with an in-built twist-off cap — a convenient, unit-dose presentation for diluting drugs, wetting dressings and flushing lines.

The solution is compounded in Swanya's clear-solution manufacturing area in batch sizes from 500 L to 2,500 L using Water for Injection, sterile-filtered with online filter integrity testing and filled on Form-Fill-Seal machines that form, fill and seal every vial in a closed cycle.
Batches are tested in-house for assay, pH, osmolality, bacterial endotoxins, sterility and particulate matter before release.
specs: Sodium chloride 0.9% w/v in Water for Injection
Single-use FFS vial with in-built twist-off cap
Sterile filtration with online integrity testing

products.name: Respules
products.tagline: 1 – 5 ml solution and suspension vials with twist-off caps
products.summary: Unit-dose respules for nebulisation — solutions and suspensions in 1 to 5 ml Form-Fill-Seal vials with twist-off caps, filled in a dedicated suspension area.
description: Respules are single-dose plastic vials for nebulised respiratory therapy. Swanya manufactures both solution and suspension respules in fill volumes from 1 ml to 5 ml on Form-Fill-Seal lines, with a twist-off cap that opens cleanly without scissors or glass.

Suspensions are handled in a separate, dedicated manufacturing area with its own equipment train, which avoids cross-contact with clear-solution products and allows the homogeneity controls that suspension dosage forms demand.
Respules are available for contract manufacturing under the partner's brand; formulation, fill volume and strip configuration are agreed at the feasibility stage.
specs: Sterile solution or suspension for inhalation (nebulisation)
FFS respule with twist-off cap, supplied in strips
Dedicated suspension area, separate from clear solutions

products.name: FFS Ampoules
products.tagline: Break-off plastic ampoules, formed, filled and sealed in one cycle
products.summary: Polymer ampoules produced on Form-Fill-Seal machines — no glass particulates, no separate closure, tamper-evident by design.
description: Form-Fill-Seal ampoules replace glass ampoules with a polymer container that is extruded, filled and sealed within seconds inside the FFS machine. The result is a tamper-evident, break-off ampoule with no glass shards, no coring and no separate stopper or cap component to qualify.
FFS ampoules suit sterile water, saline, diluents and other clear solutions where unit-dose accuracy and safe opening matter — for example emergency kits, veterinary use and hospital wards.
Fill volumes, ampoule geometry and strip configuration are defined during the contract-manufacturing feasibility study.
specs: Sterile filtration with online integrity testing
products.keywords: FFS ampoule manufacturer India, plastic ampoules Form Fill Seal
